fields.title: 📖 Imrār is not Tafwīḍ
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Qutaybah** said:

> ***“We did not see the Mufassirūn stop at anything of the Qurʾān and say: This is mutashābih, whose meaning only Allah knows; rather, they let it run completely through Tafsīr, even the disconnected letters.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement of the Salaf ***“let them pass on as they came”*** means **Imrār** with affirmation of what the text states — not **Tafwīḍ** in the sense of a total denial of meaning. What is unknown is the **Kayfiyyah**, not the linguistically understood meaning.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Qutaybah, Taʾwīl Mushkil al-Qurʾān, Abschnitt über al-Mutashābih; zitiert in Tuḥfat al-Yaqīn fī Ṣifat ʿUluw Allāh ʿalā al-ʿĀlamīn, S. 402–403.
